Markets.title: FACT, Paradeep Phosphates, RCF, other fertiliser stocks rally up to 13%. Here's why
Markets.summary: Fertiliser stocks including FACT, RCF, and Paradeep Phosphates surged up to 13% on Tuesday. The rally followed Russian President Vladimir Putin's assurance to India of uninterrupted fertiliser supplies amid the West Asia crisis.

Markets.title: ESDS Software's Rs 720-cr IPO to open on Aug 28; sets price band at Rs 408-429
Markets.summary: ESDS Software Solution has set its Rs 720-crore IPO price band at Rs 408 to Rs 429 per share. The public subscription period runs from August 28 to September 1, following an anchor investor bidding day on August 27.

Markets.title: Global Market: SK Hynix workers reject pay deal amid bonus dispute
Markets.summary: SK Hynix workers narrowly rejected a 6.3% pay raise and revised bonus structure by a margin of 25 votes. Opposition was driven by employee resistance to receiving 60% of their bonuses in shares amid ongoing stock market volatility.

Markets.title: Afcons Infrastructure shares rally 4% after receiving Rs 335.5 crore arbitration award
Markets.summary: Afcons Infrastructure shares rose 4.40% after winning a Rs 335.50 crore arbitration award against the Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority. The favorable award consists of Rs 152.25 crore in principal and Rs 183.25 crore in interest.

Markets.title: Ceigall India shares rise 4% after winning Rs 705 crore Arunachal Pradesh Frontier Highway project
Markets.summary: Ceigall India's shares rose 4% after the company and its partner won a ₹704.7 crore road construction contract in Arunachal Pradesh. The four-year engineering, procurement, and construction project includes five years of maintenance and strengthens the company's infrastructure portfolio.

Geo-Political.title: Iran says it is ready for what US calls 'greatest financial offensive ever'
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has imposed severe new sanctions on Iran, which officials are calling an economic D-Day. Tehran has responded by stating that it has a specific plan in place to counter these financial measures.

Geo-Political.title: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
Geo-Political.summary: UK Prime Minister Burnham has pledged continued support for Ukraine following Russian warnings of consequences over the reported use of British drones. Moscow had issued outrageous threats regarding the military assistance.

Geo-Political.title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
Geo-Political.summary: The Trump administration removed Syria from the U.S. list of state sponsors of terrorism. This decision followed the administration's embrace of Syria's new president, former al-Qaeda-linked militant Ahmed al-Sharaa.

Geo-Political.title: NZ religious sect leader jailed over death of Chinese follower
Geo-Political.summary: The leader of a New Zealand religious sect has been jailed following the 2024 death of 70-year-old Chinese follower Shulai Wang. Wang's body was discovered near an Auckland marina.

Geo-Political.title: French tourist dies in Death Valley after car gets stuck in mud
Geo-Political.summary: A 68-year-old French tourist died in California's Death Valley after his car became stuck in the mud. His body was discovered on the salt flats amid temperatures reaching 116°F (46.6°C).

Geo-Political.title: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
Geo-Political.summary: Australia has banned AI-generated songs from its official music charts. This decision follows a recent incident where a DJ used artificial intelligence to create a chart-topping Madonna remix.

Data & Insights.summary: A World Bank economist states that India is driving South Asia's economic growth, though its expected gains from the China+1 strategy have not yet materialized. The economist also highlights artificial intelligence as a potentially greater driver of future economic growth.

Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is considering using the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund expanded debt buybacks. According to CNBC reports citing senior officials, this strategy would target higher-yielding, older securities.

Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is negotiating trade agreements with countries and blocs representing a $15 trillion GDP. Goyal is currently visiting Japan with a delegation of over 200 business representatives to strengthen bilateral trade and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Iranian rial hits record low of 2.02 million against US dollar amid threat of new Trump sanctions — Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: Iran's currency fell 4.5% to a record low of 2.02 million rials per US dollar on August 24. The drop followed US President Donald Trump's announcement of a new "crushing economic operation" against Tehran.

Data & Insights.summary: First-quarter service producer price indices showed mixed results across sectors with 2022-23 as the base year. Air passenger services experienced a significant surge of 32%, while the government noted that aggregate weights are unassigned because the seven tracked services do not cover the entire sector.

Data & Insights.title: AI, semicon, global value chains: How globalization isn't dying—it's evolving
Data & Insights.summary: Global trade is shifting away from physical goods toward services and strategic technologies like semiconductors and artificial intelligence. Rather than disappearing, international supply chains and capital investments are simply transforming and reconfiguring.

India.title: Rs 716 Crore Bypass To Decongest Dehradun, Ease Travel From Delhi-NCR
India.summary: A new 12-kilometer, four-lane bypass costing Rs 716 crore is being built to decongest traffic in Dehradun. The project is designed to improve regional connectivity and make travel easier for commuters coming from Delhi-NCR.

India.summary: Rebel Trinamool MLA Kasem Siddiqui has left his opposition stance to return to Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee's camp. Siddiqui stated that he originally won his seat because the public voted for Banerjee and her posters.

India.title: TCS To Acquire Porsche's IT Consulting Arm MHP For 320 Million Euros
India.summary: Tata Consultancy Services has agreed to acquire Porsche's IT consulting subsidiary, MHP, for 320 million euros. This purchase is part of a larger five-year strategic partnership between TCS and the German automaker valued at 1.25 billion euros.
